settings.heading: About Guan Yiac Hardware
settings.text: Established in 1943, Guan Yiac Hardware has been supplying Philippine industry with conveyor components, industrial hoses, power transmission products, and mechanical hardware for over 80 years.

settings.heading: Your Trusted Industrial Partner
settings.text: We serve B2B and B2C buyers across Metro Manila and nationwide with 20,000+ SKUs, expert technical support, and same-day delivery on qualifying orders.
